_comment: Approved VS Code extensions for Business Central (AL) development.
_versionNote: All versions are auto-resolved at runtime from the VS Marketplace. needsVersionReview:true on all entries ensures the latest version is always fetched when the pipeline runs.

extensions.name: ms-dynamics-smb.al
extensions.description: AL Language extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central - IntelliSense, debugger, compiler

extensions.name: waldo.crs-al-language-extension
extensions.description: CRS AL Language Extension - file/object naming rules, renaming, snippets, workspace commands

extensions.name: andrzejzwierzchowski.al-code-outline
extensions.description: AZ AL Dev Tools / AL Code Outline - object/symbol tree, code generators, wizard-style creators

extensions.name: davidfeldhoff.al-codeactions
extensions.description: AL CodeActions - quick-fix actions: extract variable, sort properties, fix usings

extensions.name: bartpermentier.al-toolbox
extensions.description: AL Toolbox - region folding, related-table commands, region snippets for AL

extensions.name: rasmus.al-var-helper
extensions.description: AL Variable Helper - smart variable name suggestions following BC naming conventions

extensions.name: wbrakowski.al-navigator
extensions.description: AL Navigator - navigate to next/prev variable, go-to-related object shortcut

extensions.name: martonsagi.al-object-designer
extensions.description: AL Object Designer - visual table/page designer with drag-and-drop fields

extensions.name: StefanMaron.businesscentral-lintercop
extensions.description: BusinessCentral.LinterCop - open-source rule set on top of AL compiler; catches BC-specific anti-patterns

extensions.name: 365businessdevelopment.bdev-al-xml-doc
extensions.description: AL XML Documentation - generates XML doc comments; renders hover docs in IntelliSense

extensions.name: usernamehw.errorlens
extensions.description: Error Lens - shows AL compiler errors and LinterCop warnings inline on the code line

extensions.name: vjeko.vjeko-al-objid
extensions.description: AL Object ID Ninja - central object ID assignment for teams; prevents ID conflicts in multi-developer repos

extensions.name: jamespearson.al-test-runner
extensions.description: AL Test Runner - run and debug individual AL test codeunits and methods from within VS Code

extensions.name: rvanbekkum.xliff-sync
extensions.description: XLIFF Sync - keeps .xlf translation files in sync with g.xlf; detects missing translations

extensions.name: nabsolutions.nab-al-tools
extensions.description: NAB AL Tools - advanced XLIFF management, translation suggestions, export to external tools

extensions.name: eamodio.gitlens
extensions.description: GitLens - inline blame, rich history, branch/stash visualiser; essential for multi-developer BC repos

extensions.name: donjayamanne.githistory
extensions.description: Git History - visual log, file and line history viewer

extensions.name: ms-vscode.powershell
extensions.description: PowerShell - essential for BCContainerHelper, pipeline scripts, and Docker management

extensions.name: ms-azuretools.vscode-docker
extensions.description: Docker - manage BC Docker containers (images, logs, shell) from VS Code sidebar

extensions.name: humao.rest-client
extensions.description: REST Client - test BC OData/API endpoints directly from .http files in VS Code

extensions.name: Gruntfuggly.todo-tree
extensions.description: TODO Tree - aggregates all TODO/FIXME comments in a sidebar tree

extensions.name: wayou.vscode-todo-highlight
extensions.description: TODO Highlight - colour-highlights TODO/FIXME inline in editor

extensions.name: nwallace.createguid
extensions.description: Create GUID - insert a new GUID anywhere; needed for app.json IDs and permissions

extensions.name: ryu1kn.partial-diff
extensions.description: Partial Diff - diff any two selected text blocks; handy for comparing AL objects

extensions.name: chunsen.bracket-select
extensions.description: Bracket Select - select content inside brackets with a single shortcut

extensions.name: vscode-icons-team.vscode-icons
extensions.description: vscode-icons - file icon theme with icons for .al, .xlf, .app, Docker files

extensions.name: nikitakunevich.snippet-creator
extensions.description: snippet-creator - convert any selected AL code into a reusable snippet

extensions.name: GitHub.copilot
extensions.description: GitHub Copilot - inline AL code completions (requires Copilot subscription)

extensions.name: GitHub.copilot-chat
extensions.description: GitHub Copilot Chat - ask questions about AL code, generate test stubs (requires Copilot subscription)
